Clear Learning, Assessment and Certification Information

Important information for learners, teachers and certificate holders using GETI programs, examinations and digital certificate services.

✓

Why Choose GETI

GETI combines flexible online learning, practical assessments, structured professional development and verifiable certification in one accessible platform. Learners can develop their knowledge, demonstrate their skills and earn credentials that reflect genuine achievement.

→

How Certification Works

Choose your program, complete your registration, meet the applicable learning requirements and take the required assessment. Candidates who successfully meet the established standards receive their results and proceed through the certification process.

ID

Certificate Authenticity

Every official GETI certificate record includes a unique Certificate ID. Certificate records can be verified online using the certificate holder’s name or Certificate ID, helping employers, institutions and other authorized parties confirm their authenticity.

A+

Exam Policy

Passing requirements, examination duration and assessment levels depend on the selected program or training hours. Candidates must complete their assessments honestly and meet the required passing standard.

Once an examination has been successfully completed, the same completed examination record cannot be used to retake it.

✉

Results and Certificate Delivery

Results and certificate-related communications are sent to the email address provided during registration. Students should provide a valid and accessible email address and check it regularly for important information regarding their results and certification.

🔒

Payment and Security

When an online payment is required, transactions are processed through the third-party payment provider displayed during checkout. GETI does not request students to enter payment-card details directly on examination pages.

Students should always use the official payment process displayed on the GETI platform.

◎

Privacy and Data Protection

Registration information is used to manage student access, learning activities, examinations, results, certification, certificate verification and related support services.

Students are responsible for providing accurate and legitimate information when registering and using GETI services.

§

Academic Integrity

GETI is committed to protecting the integrity of its learning, assessment and certification system. Students must provide truthful registration information, complete assessments honestly and avoid impersonation, fraudulent activity, unauthorized alteration or misuse of GETI records and certificates.

i

Skills That Create Opportunities

More than 19,430 learners have used their GETI certification to strengthen their professional journey and pursue new career opportunities.

At GETI, certificates are earned through achievement. They are awarded to candidates who successfully demonstrate the knowledge, skills and competencies required by their program.

This approach helps ensure that every GETI certificate represents genuine achievement, verified skills and professional credibility.

★

Recognition Through Achievement

A GETI certificate represents more than the completion of a program. It recognizes the knowledge, skills and competencies demonstrated by the certificate holder through the applicable learning and assessment process.

GETI is committed to maintaining meaningful certification standards so that every credential reflects genuine achievement.

Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers about GETI programs, learning, examinations, results, certificates and student support.

How do I get started with GETI?

Choose the program or examination that matches your learning or professional goals. Complete the required registration information and follow the instructions displayed on the platform to begin.

How do I choose the right program or examination?

Review the program description, learning objectives, assessment requirements and available training options before registering. Choose the option that best matches the skills or knowledge you want to develop or demonstrate.

How do I access my lessons and examinations?

After completing the applicable registration process, use your GETI student area to access the learning materials, available activities and examinations associated with your program.

What are the requirements for passing an examination?

Passing requirements may vary by program or examination. The applicable passing score, duration and assessment conditions are displayed before or during the examination process.

How and when will I receive my examination results?

Your result is provided according to the assessment process applicable to your examination. Important result-related information may also be sent to the email address provided during registration.

How do I receive my GETI certificate after passing?

After successfully completing the applicable requirements, follow the certification instructions provided by GETI. Certificate-related information will be made available through the appropriate student or communication channel.

How can I verify the authenticity of a GETI certificate?

Official GETI certificate records include a unique Certificate ID. Use the GETI certificate verification service and enter the certificate holder's information or Certificate ID to check the corresponding record.

Can employers or institutions verify my certificate online?

Yes. Where an official certificate record is available, employers, institutions and other authorized parties can use the GETI verification service to confirm the corresponding certificate information.

Can I study and take examinations using a mobile device?

GETI can be accessed from compatible mobile devices. For examinations, a stable internet connection and an up-to-date browser are recommended to provide the best possible experience.

What happens if I do not pass an examination?

If you do not achieve the required passing score, the options available to you will depend on the rules of the selected examination or program. Follow the instructions displayed with your result for the next applicable step.

Can I retake an examination after I have already passed it?

A successfully completed examination cannot normally be retaken using the same completed examination record. This helps preserve the consistency and integrity of GETI assessment records.

What should I do if I lose my Certificate ID or certificate information?

Contact GETI Administration using the information associated with your registration. Providing accurate identification and registration details can help the administration locate the appropriate record.

How does GETI protect the integrity of its examinations and certificates?

GETI uses assessment rules, student identification information, certificate records and unique Certificate IDs to support the integrity and verification of its certification process. Fraudulent alteration, impersonation and misuse of GETI records are prohibited.

How can I contact GETI Administration if I need assistance?

For assistance with registration, examinations, results, certificates, verification or account access, contact GETI Administration at admin@getienglish.com.

GETI Certificates: TEFL and TESOL

Learn about the main GETI certificate pathways for TEFL and TESOL. This page presents the TEFL and TESOL certificate options, entry expectations, learning routes, sample certificates and online verification services.

Features of GETI Certificates

  • International-style digital certificates across English teaching, English studies and professional development programs.
  • Flexible online study and examination pathways for hour-based certificate programs and program-based assessments.
  • Unique Certificate IDs can be issued for official online verification through the GETI verification system.
  • Certificate records can be searched by Certificate ID, holder name or nationality.
  • GETI certificate services are connected to lessons, examinations, student accounts, results and certificate request services.

General Entry Requirements for GETI Certificates

  • Ability to follow the language of the selected program and complete online study tasks.
  • No specific nationality is required to study through the GETI online platform.
  • A university degree is not required for general entry unless a specific employer, authority or external destination later requests one.
  • An internet-connected phone, tablet or computer is required for lessons, assessments, account access and certificate services.

Available GETI Certificates

English Teaching Certificates

GETI currently highlights two main certificate pathways on this page: TEFL and TESOL. These pathways are designed for future English teachers and trainers and can be followed through hour-based options such as 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120, 140, 150, 180, 200, 250, 300 and 420 hours depending on the selected exam option.

Explore a GETI Program

How should I start a GETI certificate program?

Step 1 — Create a Student Account

Open a GETI account to access lessons, exams, results and certificate services.

Step 2 — Choose Your Program

Select either the TEFL or TESOL pathway that matches your learning goal.

Step 3 — Study and Complete Assessments

Follow the lessons and complete the examinations connected to your selected TEFL or TESOL program.

Step 4 — Receive and Verify Your Certificate

After passing, use GETI result and certificate services, then verify the issued record online with the Certificate ID.

GETI EXAM OVERVIEW

Teaching Qualifications at a Glance

Compare the purpose and assessment focus of the three principal GETI English teaching examinations.

TESOL
PurposeTeaching English to speakers of other languages
AssessmentKnowledge, planning and classroom application
TESOL exams assess the knowledge and practical skills required to teach English to speakers of other languages. Candidates demonstrate lesson planning, language awareness, classroom management, assessment, learner support and professional judgment. Available course hours offer progressive challenge, with clear pass requirements and automatic correction for an efficient, consistent examination experience.
TEFL
PurposeTeaching English as a foreign language
AssessmentMethods, language knowledge and teaching practice
TEFL exams measure readiness to teach English as a foreign language in international classrooms. Each assessment reviews teaching methods, grammar, pronunciation, lesson preparation, classroom practice and learner evaluation. Exam duration and difficulty increase with course hours, helping candidates demonstrate stronger competence before earning a verified GETI teaching certificate online successfully.
TEYL
PurposeTeaching English to young learners
AssessmentAge-appropriate, safe and engaging instruction
TEYL exams focus on teaching English effectively to children and young learners. Candidates are assessed on age appropriate instruction, engaging lesson structure, simple language presentation, classroom routines, safeguarding awareness and supportive feedback. Different study hours provide suitable progression while the examination checks practical understanding, confidence and responsible teaching decisions independently.
